scope.description: Raise branch coverage readiness for partial module tails.
scope.strategy: Improve branch coverage and prepare for hard branch gate enforcement when stable above 85%.

promotion_criteria: branch-rate remains at or above 85% for three consecutive coverage-verify runs
no module is unmeasured or uncovered in module-coverage-inventory
top-ranked low-tail modules have focused branch/error-path owner tests
branch_coverage_gate_requirements.rationale: Hard branch gate enforcement is promoted through scripts.engineering.qa check-branch-coverage in the canonical coverage-verify lane after three consecutive passing local branch-gate checks on the refreshed coverage XML.

closeout.rationale: Issue #5978 has a clean branch baseline at 85.002% with no unmeasured or uncovered modules, all 6 ranked low-tail modules have focused owner tests added, and branch coverage is now blocking through scripts.engineering.qa check-branch-coverage in the canonical coverage-verify lane.
